criteria_results.text: The app/backend boots cleanly against the fork engine (no error-level noise, no spurious engine restarts)
criteria_results.notes: verification-gate ran tsc+vitest+flutter analyze/test but never BOOTED the server, so two startup-only defects were invisible: (A) ~30 reloadSkills ECONNREFUSED errors because the run-once skill backfill reloads skills before the engine listens on :4096 (pre-existing; fixed via isReady guard in opencode_client_service.ts); (B) the #856 auth watcher bounced the engine on its OWN OAuth access-token refresh because it compared raw auth.json bytes incl. volatile access/expires (regression from this run's #856; fixed by comparing a stable identity fingerprint type+refresh/key in auth_credential_watcher.ts, +5 tests).

criteria_results.text: #857: the seeded org-optimizer cron stays OFF until the data-sufficiency guard lands
criteria_results.notes: The #857 contract asserted the GUARD (thin-history -> no tighten) and passed, but the coding-agent CLAIMED 'cron stays OFF by construction' without verifying it. Boot log shows [org-optimizer-seed] seeded 'Org Self-Optimizer' (daily @ 02:00) — the cron was seeded-ON by the earlier mega build (org_optimizer_seed.ts, unchanged this run) and runs every startup. Not a code bug in this run; a verification/doc gap. project-state corrected; maintainer decided to leave cron on and merge #882 before 02:00 so the guard is on main.

process_issues.description: The parallel-worktree pattern symlinked one shared apps/api_server/node_modules across 8 worktrees; agents running npm ci/install concurrently raced and stripped better-sqlite3 mid-run, producing phantom 'module missing' failures. Mitigated by repairing between waves + a 'do not reinstall' rule for wave 2.
process_issues.detected_by: wave-2 agent reports + direct node_modules inspection (typescript/better-sqlite3 missing after a green full-suite run)

issues.description: #857 coding-agent claimed 'cron stays OFF by construction; verified no enable/pause toggle exists' — an unverified completion claim. The cron was in fact seeded-ON in the scheduler DB; the agent never booted to confirm.
issues.detected_by: boot log [org-optimizer-seed] seeded lines vs the agent's report + project-state claim

issues.description: verification-gate emitted PASS on build+unit+analyze but did not boot the server / probe a health-and-startup path, so startup-only defects (reloadSkills ordering, #856 self-bounce) escaped the gate and were only caught in manual smoke.
issues.detected_by: manual smoke found two boot-time issues absent from the gate evidence

failure_output: [ERROR] [OpencodeClientService] reloadSkills failed: TypeError: fetch failed ... connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:4096 ;; [AuthCredentialWatcher] auth.json changed — bouncing engine to reload credentials ;; [org-optimizer-seed] seeded "Org Self-Optimizer" (daily @ 02:00)
suggested_follow_up: verification-gate should include a boot-smoke for server-spawning repos: launch the backend against the real engine and assert zero error-level log lines + no spurious engine restart in the first N seconds, before claiming PASS.
